observations.what: Triangular dorsal fin crest extending vertically from the upper cervicothoracic spine
Smooth, high-value unshaded shark cranial cowl curving downward toward the snout
Open toothy selachian jaw with exposed serrated teeth and dark interior shading
Dark almond-shaped sunken eye slit set into the smooth cranial hood
Three dark vertical graphite gill slits behind the jaw hinge on the neck
Dense arched quadrupedal back and torso covered in rough, directional fur strokes
Left forelimb planted heavily forward ending in four rounded digitigrade paw pads
Muscular right foreleg stepping inward with thick fur contours and broad paw base
Heavy rear haunch and hind leg braced backward against the lower terrain
Long, thick fin-rimmed tail sweeping in an S-curve along the beast's right flank
Sharply pointed crescent caudal fin tip curling along the bottom foreground edge
Untouched off-white paper ground framing the entire creature silhouette

composition.mass: Visual weight pools heavily across the north-central high ridge [cols 3-8, rows 2-5] where the arched spine peaks at tier 3, sloping southward into the looping tail pathway.
composition.read: The level enters from the southern shore along a sweeping S-curve path mimicking the long tail fin sweep in the drawing. As the eye ascends the winding moraine path, it is guided around the eastern flank through rib gates toward the western headland where the beast waits poised over the void.

lens.summary: A massive arched mound whose structural spine and sweeping caudal causeway directly replicate the prowling silhouette of the drawing.
lens.differs: Unlike the fractured planar slate moraine of the medium reading, this layout directly translates the anatomical volume and curving gestural flow lines into continuous stepped terrain terraces and looping spine paths.

concept.name: lens-composition
concept.fragment: LENS "composition": the drawing's STRUCTURE becomes the terrain literally. Start from ANALYSIS.composition. The main mass becomes the highest land, placed where it sits in the frame; the flow lines become the path and the ridges, running the same way; the negative space becomes void (bays and gaps cut into the island) or open ground; symmetry or its absence decides "symmetric" versus an asymmetric shaper; scale cues decide how big the figure stands against the land. Choose the shaper and its params as a transcription: peak, center, from, ratio, split, turns and hand must be read off the frame positions in the analysis (x left to right 0..1, z top to bottom 0..1). Map picture to plan this way: the top of the frame is the far rim (row 0), the bottom is the near rim (row 11). Lighting follows ANALYSIS.palette.value_structure: where the lights and darks fall becomes where sun and shadow fall, and a high-key or low-key picture sets ambient. The figure stands at the focal point and its pose repeats the drawing's main gesture line. Palette follows the value map: the surfaces are ranked by value as the picture's areas are (the emptiest area becomes the palest surface, the densest the darkest), with the piece's accent hue kept for the focal point and its threshold. Props mark the structure: posts along a flow line, a gap where the negative space opens, a counterweight at the second mass.
